issues.jp_before: あの店員[てんいん]さんは{気[き]が短[みじか]い|id-ki2}から、注文[ちゅうもん]が遅[おそ]いとすぐ文句[もんく]を言[い]うよ。
issues.problem: Illogical scene: a shop clerk complaining when an order is slow; English 'if an order is slow' unclear.
issues.action: Changed subject to お客さん and 注文 to 料理; English updated to 'That customer ... if the food is slow to come.'

issues.jp_before: 妻[つま]は{気[き]が利[き]く|id-ki2}人[ひと]で、私[わたし]が疲[つか]れているとすぐ分[わ]かってくれる。
issues.problem: Merely noticing tiredness is 察しがいい / 気がつく rather than 気が利く, which needs a considerate action.
issues.action: Rewrote the second clause as すぐ温かいお茶を入れてくれる; English updated.

issues.jp_before: 全部[ぜんぶ]言[い]いたいことを言[い]ったら、やっと{気[き]が済[す]んだ|id-ki2}。
issues.problem: Awkward word order (全部 before the relative clause).
issues.action: Reordered to 言いたいことを全部言ったら.

issues.jp_before: 彼女[かのじょ]はいつも周[まわ]りの人[ひと]に{気[き]を遣[つか]いすぎる|id-ki2}ので、自分[じぶん]の意見[いけん]が言[い]えない。
issues.problem: English 'too worried about others' does not quite capture 気を遣う (being considerate of others' feelings).
issues.action: English changed to 'She always worries too much about other people's feelings, ...'.

issues.jp_before: 初[はじ]めてのバイトは、先輩[せんぱい]が優[やさ]しい人[ひと]なので{気[き]が楽[らく]です|id-ki2}。
issues.problem: Distractors lacked the polite ending that the answer 気が楽です carries, so the form gave the answer away.
issues.action: Distractors changed to 気が重いです, 気が短いです, 気が散ります.
